title: _In vitro_ antimicrobial assay using chemically reconstituted system with hemocyanin or hemoglobin
protocol: Prepare the bacterial culture as described in protocol #4.
Adjust the bacterial population to 10^6 - 10^7 cfu/ml.
Incubate bacteria under test at 10^6 cfu/ml with 60 μg purified HMC plus 100 nmol 4-methylcatechol (4ME) in 100 μl PBS at 37°C for 1 h.
Plate 100 μl of serially diluted samples on nutrient agar plates and incubate at 37°C overnight.
Perform the colony count and calculate bacterial cfu/ml.
Add 10 nmol phenylthiourea (PTU) to reactions to evaluate PO activity impact.
Set up controls by incubating bacteria with HMC/PPO, 4ME, or PTU separately, or in combinations.
Mix each bacterial strain at 10^7 cfu/ml with 60 μg HMC/PPO and 100 nmol 4ME in 100 μl PBS.
Apply one μl of the mixture to fluorescence microscopy.
Examine it at magnification of 63 x 1.6, with time-elapse method.
Capture images at intervals of 30 s for 1 h and make a movie.
Incubate bacteria under test at 10^6 cfu/ml with 36 μg metHb and 1.6 μmol H2O2 in 200 μl PBS at 37°C for 1 h.
Plate 100 μl of serially diluted samples on nutrient agar plates.
Incubate the plates at 37°C overnight.
Count the colonies and calculate the bacterial cfu/ml.
Apply 2 μmol GSH to the incubation mixture to quench superoxide ions.
Set up controls by incubating bacteria with metHb separately.
Set up controls by incubating bacteria with H₂O₂ separately.
Set up controls by incubating bacteria with GSH separately.
Incubate bacteria with combinations of metHb, H₂O₂, and GSH.
